pending_verification.reason: The seed intentionally contains verified structure, catalogs, IDs and UI-state semantics, but not bulk verbatim book prose. Rule-body fields are null and source-linked.
Verified as present and interactive, but not yet normalized into per-option records for all nine playbooks.
Several possessions contain nested uses/load/text blanks and need item-by-item semantic normalization rather than treating every printed diamond as the same control.
Move names and selection checkboxes are verified. Nested text blanks, uses, hold, level notes and prerequisite relationships are not exhaustively normalized for every move.
Core fields and the Bird example are verified; the complete animal-type/trait catalog has not been normalized.
Core stats and tag catalog are represented; inventory, individual-member details and Order Followers subsections remain to normalize.
All five named initiates are included; their complete individual follower-card stats/moves are not yet normalized.
Insert state model and one verified invocation are included; the complete invocation list is not yet normalized.
Core state shapes and verified instincts/moves are included, but all consequences/marks/impulses are not yet normalized.
All 64 names and ordinals are verified. Card-specific tags, requirements, front/reverse text and controls are intentionally left pending.
All 18 names and ordinals are verified. Per-Arcanum progress boxes, mysteries, unlock conditions and consequences are not yet normalized.
